title: Elements 19-36: period 4
trouble: Rereading feels like knowing; it is not. Recall, then check.

blocks.html: Row four holds the first transition metals, the everyday metals of tools, coins and wires: iron, copper, zinc, nickel. Every element in this list is in period 4.

How to hold it: Learn the row in three chunks that match the table's shape: the two s-block metals (K, Ca), the ten transition metals (Sc to Zn), then the six p-block elements (Ga to Kr). For the ten metals, a memory palace works well: ten spots along a workbench, each with its metal doing a job. Watch the odd symbols: K is potassium (Latin kalium) and Fe is iron (Latin ferrum).
